text:
ash: Alert — spike in mTLS handshake failures in us-west-1 starting ~2026-05-02T22:10Z. Logs show 'chain validate error' and 'private key unavailable'. Anyone oncall?
yuki: Im looking. Proxy logs indicate certs served but clients fail verify because intermediates missing. rotator logs show issuance succeeded but a follow-on unwrap step failed with 'access condition mismatch'.
ben: Correlating with IAM/audit: KMS audit shows 'PermissionDenied: condition not met' for rotator principal at 2026-05-02T22:09:58Z. The binding uses an IAM condition restricting access to requests from a specific VPC or with a tag `environment=prod`. rotator requests are coming from a different tag after the new connectivity change.
ash: Wait — who applied that IAM condition? That sounds like the recent secure-by-default policy we rolled out.
yuki: Looks like tf-priv-policy #789 added a condition on the KMS binding last night. It tightened scope to `resource.name.startsWith("projects/infra/locations/us-west") && request.auth.claims.environment == "prod"`. Rotator's service identity didn't include the claim because it runs in a multi-tenant infra cluster.
ben: So rotator couldn't unwrap the CA key; it logged issuance but couldn't complete chain construction. Proxies received partial cert bundles (missing intermediates). Clients reject the handshake.
ash: Immediate steps: 1) temporarily relax the condition to allow rotator principal to unwrap, 2) restart rotator to force unwrap and push full chains, 3) evict proxy cert caches. Who can patch IAM quickly?
yuki: I can apply a short-lived exception scope via console while infra authors fix TF rules. Applying now and logging the exception as required by policy.
kms-bot: Audit note: temporary exception applied by yuki for principal `serviceAccount:rotator-us-west@redwood.iam` at 2026-05-02T22:14Z; TTL 20m.
yuki: Exception in place. KMS audit now shows Allow for rotator-us-west.
ben: Triggering rotator restart: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/rotator --region=us-west-1`
ops-bot: Restart queued for rotator-us-west. Pods will restart sequentially.
yuki: Rotator logs after restart show `unwrap_ok` and `chain_pushed` events. Partial success reported: handshake success up from 72% -> 92% within 6m.
ash: We still have a tail — some older edge proxies held stale certs. Rolling them now: `kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy --region=us-west-1`.
ops-bot: Edge proxies restart started.
ben: Handshake failures down to 0.6% after 10m. Good. Root cause: IAM conditional binding blocked rotator in a mixed-identity environment. Secondary cause: rotator emitted "issued" before confirming unwrap, so proxies briefly served incomplete chains.
yuki: Post-incident items I'm proposing: - Update TF rule templates to avoid overly strict IAM conditions on KMS keys used by rotator; require a review step if conditions are added. - Add a CI pre-apply lint that flags conditional bindings on CA keys where principals have `tag:rotator` or `role:cert-issuer`. - Make rotator atomic: do not emit final 'issued' event until unwrap_ok confirmed; emit `issuance_pending` metric otherwise. - Add metric/alert: KMS "PermissionDenied: condition not met" or `AccessDenied` spikes -> page sec-oncall. - Shorten cert-cache TTL during rotations (default to 4m) and ensure legacy proxies are updated. - Enhance audit correlation: surface TF plan id and IAM condition diffs alongside KMS audit lines in the console.
ben: Also add a vulnerability triage note: conditional IAM policies can be brittle when identity claims or network tags change. We should document safe patterns for KMS keys (prefer principal-scoped roles vs complex conditions) and add to the infosec runbook.
ash: I'll file the SEC ticket and assign infra and rotator owners. Include runbook steps for temporary exceptions, explicit exception TTLs, and postmortem checklist.
yuki: Filing SEC-52019: "IAM condition blocked KMS unwrap for rotator -> partial mTLS chain served (us-west-1)" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-52019
ops-bot: SEC-52019 created and linked to TF change tf-priv-policy#789 and KMS audit entries.
ben: Quick follow-ups: add rotator metrics `unwrap_confirmed` and `issuance_pending_count`; add dashboard panel for KMS conditional deny counts; and add TF pre-apply blocker for CA key condition diffs.
yuki: Agreed. Also schedule a tabletop to review IAM condition use cases so we avoid collateral outages.
ash: Thanks team. Closing thread; will reopen if alert fires again. :thumbsup:
